elapsed_wall_seconds.per_stage_durations: not recorded in safe receipts; token counts are not duration estimates

limits.citation_scope_coverage: Actual citation counts are retained; this batch exercised passage citations only when source counts are zero.
limits.cleanup: Cleanup and process exit were recorded and hashed by the reader before/after each disposable run; aggregation did not restart models or reconstruct deleted databases.
limits.decision_breakdown: The receipts retain exact suggestion binding and resolution counts, not accepted/rejected totals.
limits.generation_failure_root_cause: One F1 numeric validation failure and successful retry are recorded; rejected prose is neither retained nor reconstructed.
limits.injection: The single fixed injection fixture passed its exact marker and product gates; this is not a general prompt-injection resistance claim.
limits.language_and_prose: Language gates and final validator passed; API receipts do not retain prose for a fresh semantic-quality read. Browser reading remains separately bound to its earlier source.
limits.privacy: Only operational counts, closed diagnostic categories, booleans and hashes are published. No user text, credentials, private paths, original review advice or report body.
limits.time: Total is the sum of five recorded per-run wall times; no per-stage timings were recorded.
limits.unretained_identity_hashes: Disposable identifiers and report bodies were deleted. Opaque run/report/snapshot identifier hashes in original receipts cannot be regenerated now and are omitted from this public aggregate.

provenance.source_manifest_digest_definition: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON of sorted repository-relative file to SHA-256 mapping

scope: Five fixed local API scenarios on one product source and one operational reader; real local Qwen runtime through FastAPI lifespan and in-process ASGI HTTP. Not a randomized reliability estimate or a prediction-efficacy result.
